description: The employer page a printed name belongs to: an exact match, a possible one with the matched name, or none. It comes with the employer's PERM decisions, certified share, pending cases, newest filing and H-1B LCAs. No key: it's what the browser extension calls, under shared limits of 60 calls a minute per address. Example: {"name":"Google"}.

name.description: The employer's name as a job posting prints it, 2 to 120 characters. Example: Google.

name: lookup_employer

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: The employer page a printed name belongs to, with its PERM record.

h1bLcas.description: H-1B labor condition applications in DOL's published files, FY2008 on: certified, denied and withdrawn. The E-3 and H-1B1 LCAs filed on the same form aren't counted. Null when it couldn't be read.

name.description: The employer's name as DOL's files print it.

page.description: perm: a published PERM sponsor. live: PERM filings DOL hasn't published yet. other: H-1B, wage-request or seasonal filings only.

certifiedShare.description: certified / (certified + denied), or null under the floor.

filingsLast12Months.description: PERM cases filed in the last 12 months.

newestFiling.description: The newest filing date the live record holds.

pending.description: Cases DOL's live record shows still open.

published.description: PERM cases in DOL's published files.

slug.description: Its name in its page's address.

wageRequests.description: Prevailing wage requests, published and live.

employer.description: The employer the name belongs to, or null when match is none.

match.description: exact: the name is this employer's. possible: the closest employer, to be shown as a maybe. none: no employer page fits.

shareFloor.description: Under this many decided cases, no certified share is given.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Match an employer's name to its page
